case_number: 2025 INSC 140; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.__________OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 9115 of 2018)
summary: Conviction under Section 302 IPC altered to Section 304 Part I IPC; evidence shows sudden provocation due to altercation; no premeditation established; eye witnesses corroborate assault but not motive; cordial prior relations between parties; sentence of 8.5 years with remission deemed sufficient; release ordered.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.304 Part I
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; conviction under Section 302 IPC altered to Section 304 Part I IPC; appellant directed to be released forthwith.
